settings.selection: Six previously diagnosed cases plus two previously false-positive cases. Development diagnostic, not held-out.
settings.technical_recovery: One identical-input retry at max_tokens=65536 for non-complete or invalid-JSON output; all arms/stages, no semantic retry.
settings.A_direct: Old top-eight annotations; judge directly twice, then common final review.
settings.B_split: Same old annotations; propose scenarios, refine, then common final review.
settings.C_open: Neutral public evidence; propose scenarios, refine, then common final review.
settings.D_static: Same as C plus automatic local Boolean influence contrasts.
settings.E_semantic: LLM first maps public requirements to source observations; program resolves locations and computes local contrasts; LLM proposes scenarios, then common final review.
settings.F_plan_only: Reuses E_semantic first-stage plan and retrieval, with computed program feedback removed.

settings.selection: Same eight development cases as preceding contrast pilot, chosen before calls for mechanism comparison. Not held-out; no population claim.
settings.technical_recovery: One identical-input retry on incomplete/invalid JSON/top-level list length; no semantic retries. Prepared or ambiguous inflight records are not silently resent.
settings.A_artifacts: Issue, submitted source windows, same test code excerpts and literal call inventory; no event timeline or episode feedback. Test excerpts can originate from history, so this ablates event context, not all trajectory-derived artifacts.
settings.B_history: Same artifacts plus program-retrieved chronological index, test/event associations and selected read/edit/execute episodes. Three model stages: discovery, refinement, review.
settings.C_plan: History evidence; model proposes at most two finite behavioral models and source/history queries; then two scenario/review stages without computed feedback.
settings.D_computed: Shares exact C stage-1 plan and source/history retrieval. Adds literal test bindings and bounded finite contrast computation. Same remaining prompts and budgets.

settings.selection: Six already studied development tasks: four with known repair-relevant combination targets and two with prior selection/false-positive opportunities. T11/T23 are not assumed bug-free. No held-out generalization claim.
settings.stage1: Up to two hypotheses and six source/test/AST/history queries.
settings.stage2: Choose one target, report a decision, and generate up to two files/three named tests. Execute on the original patch.
settings.stage3: One full revision with actual original-patch execution feedback, or identical-budget self-review in D. Execute final tests; evaluator separately checks their conditions and oracle.
settings.technical_recovery: At most one identical-input retry for a completed invalid/incomplete response. Ambiguous inflight calls are not silently resent. All attempts remain recorded.

arms_definition.A_source: Open investigator, final source and same original test bodies; source/test/AST shared-call queries; no development events.
arms_definition.B_history: Same open investigator, plus automatically indexed development history and original history queries.
arms_definition.C_validation: Same evidence/tools/call budget as B, but explicitly uses original validation's context and history to propose a transferable test target; no mandatory source-pair or full semantic model.
arms_definition.D_no_feedback: Shares the exact C inspection, retrieval and draft test. Final model review receives no execution output. Isolates runtime feedback at the repair step.

settings.selection: Previous six cases plus SHA256(seed:case_id) first four Python/one Go/one TypeScript from the remaining original 30; no outcome-based replacement.
stages: Propose up to three ranked hypotheses and six read-only queries.
Refine targets and propose one diagnostic observation file per target.
After diagnostic feedback or self-review, generate up to three independent augmentations.
One revision after original-patch test execution; final execution follows.
settings.reasoning_effort: medium parameter retained; thinking disabled; inspect returned usage rather than assume backend behavior
settings.technical_recovery: One identical-input retry after terminal incomplete/invalid output. No evaluator input or manual semantic edit. Never resend ambiguous inflight calls.
settings.A_final: Current issue/patch source/current test bodies only. Original-source queries and AST local slices.
settings.B_versions: A plus recovered historical test bodies, same-name version differences, and literal test edit fragments. No notes or execution events.
settings.C_history: B plus automatically indexed original reasoning, source-edit and execution events.
settings.D_probe: Shares exactly C investigation, queries, ranked hypotheses and diagnostic probe code. Receives original-patch probe executions before generating final tests; C performs self-review without these outputs.
settings.E_observations: Reuses D_probe investigation and diagnostic outputs; removes structured status and Go test banners, retains values/errors/exit codes, and adds a general explanation that completion is not a correctness verdict. All 12 cases and both repeats.
